topic: Asking the Clinic for a Chinese Interpreter

script.title: AT THE FRONT DESK
script.scene_zh: 診所櫃台 · 預約口譯
script.story_hook: A checkup, but he wants to understand everything.
script.intro_zh: 來做健檢，但他更想聽懂醫師說的每一個字。
script.welcome_en: Hello, welcome to today's clinic desk. Listen for polite ways to ask.
script.welcome_zh: 你好，歡迎來到今天的診所櫃台。留意有禮貌的請求說法。
script.outro: Interpreter booked, and nobody had to guess. Listen again and join in.
script.outro_zh: 口譯訂好了，誰也不用猜來猜去。再聽一遍，跟著一起說。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: an older man in his late sixties with thin white hair combed flat over balding temples, deep smile lines, reading glasses on a black cord, a brown corduroy jacket over a checked flannel shirt, and a slightly stooped build
script.char_b_description: a young woman in her twenties with long dark hair in a high ponytail, a small nose stud, a teal clinic polo shirt with a plastic name badge, quick friendly smile, and a slim build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a checkup Thursday, three o'clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ hæv ə ˈtʃɛkˌʌp ˈθɝzdeɪ θɹi oʊˈklɑk/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我週四有個健檢，三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, Mr… sorry, may I ask your name?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm ˈmɪstɚ sɔɹi meɪ aɪ æsk jɔɹ ˈneɪm/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎您，請問……我可以知道怎麼稱呼您嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's Wu. And, um, I have one request.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts wu ænd ʌm aɪ hæv wʌn rɪˈkwɛst/
dialogue.zh: 我姓吳。那個，嗯，我有一個請求。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, how can I help today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs haʊ kən aɪ hɛlp təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，有什麼可以幫您的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I have a Chinese interpreter with me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kən aɪ hæv ə tʃaɪˈnis ɪnˈtɝːprətɚ wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 我可以請一位中文口譯陪我嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely, that's totally possible here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæbsəˌlutli ðæts ˈtɑɾəli ˈpɑsəbəl hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 當然沒問題，這個在我們診所做得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good. My English is, um, just okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ɡʊd maɪ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪz ʌm dʒʌst oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就好。我的英文嘛，嗯，就還行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem at all, this happens daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm ət ˈɔl ðɪs ˈhæpənz ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 完全不用在意，我們幾乎天天都遇到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a charge for that service?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə tʃɑɹdʒ fɚ ðæt ˈsɝːvəs/
dialogue.zh: 這個服務要收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never, interpreters are free at our clinic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvɚ ɪnˈtɝːprətɚz ɑɹ fɹi æt aʊɹ ˈklɪnɪk/
dialogue.zh: 從來不收，口譯在我們診所是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free? Really? That surprises me, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi ˈɹiəli ðæt səɹˈpɹaɪzəz mi ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 免費？真的嗎？老實說讓我吃一驚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the law, actually, language help is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ðə lɔ ˈæktʃuəli ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ hɛlp ɪz fɹi/
dialogue.zh: 其實這是法律規定，語言協助必須免費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that's good news. Who would come?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðæts ɡʊd nuz hu wʊd kʌm/
dialogue.zh: 那可真是好消息。會來的是哪位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We work with an agency, a lady named Iris.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɝk wɪð æn ˈeɪdʒənsi ə ˈleɪdi neɪmd ˈaɪɹɪs/
dialogue.zh: 我們跟一家機構配合，有位叫 Iris 的口譯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And she would sit right inside the room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ʃi wʊd sɪt ɹaɪt ɪnˈsaɪd ðə ɹʊm/
dialogue.zh: 她會直接坐在診間裡面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she'd stay with you the whole visit.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃi d steɪ wɪð ju ðə hoʊl ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是的，整個就診過程她都會陪著您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing. My kid planned to come translate.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ maɪ kɪd plænd tə kʌm trænzˈleɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了。本來我的孩子想來幫我翻譯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, um, we actually can't use family.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ʌm wi ˈæktʃuəli kænt juz ˈfæməli/
dialogue.zh: 呃，老實說，我們不能用家屬當口譯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not even my own kid? Why is that?
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈivən maɪ oʊn kɪd waɪz ˈðæt/
dialogue.zh: 連我自己的都不行嗎？為什麼呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clinic rules say family can't be the interpreter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɪnɪk ɹulz seɪ ˈfæməli kænt bi ði ɪnˈtɝːprətɚ/
dialogue.zh: 診所規定，家屬不能擔任口譯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see… it feels strange, but okay.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt filz streɪnd bʌt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我懂了……感覺有點怪，但好吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps things accurate, you know, medically.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kipz θɪŋz ˈækjɚət ju noʊ məˈdɪkəli/
dialogue.zh: 這是為了醫療訊息準確，您懂的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, true. Family messages get mixed up fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm tru ˈfæməli ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz ɡɛt mɪkst ʌp fæst/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，也是。家人傳話，很容易傳錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. So shall I book Iris for Thursday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli soʊ ʃæl aɪ bʊk ˈaɪɹɪs fɚ ˈθɝzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。那我幫您約 Iris 週四來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please. Does she need much notice?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz dʊz ʃi nid mʌtʃ ˈnoʊtəs/
dialogue.zh: 好的，請。需要提前多久約？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-eight hours, so today works perfectly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti ˈeɪt ˈaʊɚz soʊ təˈdeɪ wɝks ˈpɝːfɪktli/
dialogue.zh: 四十八小時，所以今天開口剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Today is Tuesday… so we're just on time?
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ɪz ˈtuzdeɪ soʊ wɪɹ dʒʌst ɑn taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 今天是星期二……所以剛好趕上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just on time! I'll flag it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ɑn taɪm aɪl flæɡ ɪt ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 剛剛好！我這就幫您標記處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Is there another way, maybe?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ɪz ðɛr ə ˈnʌðɚ weɪ ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。還有沒有別的安排方式？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You mean a backup plan, sure thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju min ə ˈbækˌʌp plæn ʃɝ θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 您是說備用方案？當然有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if, um, nobody comes Thursday?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf ʌm ˈnoʊbədi kʌmz ˈθɝzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 如果，嗯，週四沒有人來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we use a phone interpreter, no stress.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi juz ə foʊn ɪnˈtɝːprətɚ noʊ stɹɛs/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就用電話口譯，別緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A phone? How would that even work?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə foʊn haʊ wʊd ðæt ˈivən wɝk/
dialogue.zh: 電話？那個要怎麼運作？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Speakerphone on the table, live translator.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspiːkɚfoʊn ɑn ðə ˈtæbəl laɪv trænzˌleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 把擴音放桌上，現場即時翻譯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow. Is that good, honestly? The phone one?
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ɪz ðæt ɡʊd ˈɑnəstli ði foʊn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哇。那個真的好用嗎？電話的那個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pretty good, though in-person beats it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɹɪti ɡʊd ðoʊ ɪn ˈpɝːsən bits ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 滿好用的，不過真人還是比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll take in-person if she's confirmed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl teɪk ɪn ˈpɝːsən ɪf ʃiz kənˈfɜɹmd/
dialogue.zh: 那我選真人，如果她確定能來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me call the agency right now…
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi kɔl ði ˈeɪdʒənsi ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就打電話給那家機構……

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, I'll wait right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔɹ taɪm aɪl weɪt ɹaɪt hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 不急，我就在這裡等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, news: Iris is in on Thursdays.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ nuz ˈaɪɹɪs ɪz ɑn ˈθɝzˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 好了，消息是：Iris 週四有排班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, wonderful! What time exactly works?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈwʌndɚfʊl wʌt taɪm ɪɡˈzæktli wɝks/
dialogue.zh: 噢，太好了！幾點的時間對得上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She can do three, matches your slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kən du θɹi ˈmætʃəz jɔɹ slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 她可以三點，跟您的時段一模一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect timing. Should I tell my kid?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝːfɪkt ˈtaɪmɪŋ ʃʊd aɪ tɛl maɪ kɪd/
dialogue.zh: 時間完美。這個我要跟孩子說一聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please do, she can still come along.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du ʃi kən stɪl kʌm əˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 請說，她還是可以一起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: As a guest, not as the translator?
dialogue.phonetic: /æz ə ɡɛst nɑt æz ðə trænzˈleɪtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 以親人的身份坐著，不用翻譯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly that, family may sit in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt ˈfæməli meɪ sɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣，家人可以在旁邊坐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll love that. She worries a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil lʌv ðæt ʃi ˈwɝiz ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 她會很開心的，她總是很擔心我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One small form, sign here for the visit.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl fɔɹm saɪn hɪɹ fɚ ðə ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一張小表格，為了就診在這裡簽一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just my name? Do I write it in English?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst maɪ neɪm du aɪ ɹaɪt ɪt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ/
dialogue.zh: 只簽名字嗎？要用英文寫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Either language, we'll copy it down for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːðɚ ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ wil ˈkɑpi ɪt daʊn fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 那種語言都行，我們會幫您抄一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, very kind. Do I need to come early?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ vɛɹi kaɪnd du aɪ nid tə kʌm ˈɜɹli/
dialogue.zh: 哈，你們真好。我需要早一點到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes early, meet me at this desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnəts ˈɜɹli mit mi æt ðɪs dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 早十分鐘，到這個櫃台找我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if I'm late? Traffic happens, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf aɪm leɪt ˈtɹæfɪk ˈhæpənz ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 遲到了怎麼辦？塞車難免的，你知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call ahead, they wait fifteen minutes for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl əˈhɛd ðeɪ weɪt ˌfɪfˈtin ˈmɪnəts fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 提前打來就好，他們會等您十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it all. Can I get this in writing?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ɔl kən aɪ ɡɛt ðɪs ɪn ˈɹaɪtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 都記下了。可以白紙黑字給我一份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's a card: interpreter booked, Thursday three.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz ə kɑɹd ɪnˈtɝːprətɚ bʊkt ˈθɝzdeɪ θɹi/
dialogue.zh: 這有張小卡：口譯已訂好，週四三點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For my kid's fridge, she'll want to see.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚ maɪ kɪdz fɹɪdʒ ʃil wɑnt tə si/
dialogue.zh: 要貼在我家孩子的冰箱上，她想看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, fridge duty, very official indeed.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ fɹɪdʒ ˈdudi ˈvɛɹi əˈfɪʃəl ɪnˈdid/
dialogue.zh: 哈，冰箱公告，真是太正式了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've made this so easy, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊv meɪd ðɪs soʊ ˈizi θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 你讓這件事變得好輕鬆，真的謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See you Thursday, Mr. Wu, take care.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ju ˈθɝzdeɪ ˈmɪstɚ wu teɪk kɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 週四見，吳先生，請好好照顧自己。

script.youtube_title: 【診所裡請中文口譯🗣️】「家屬不能擔任口譯」🎧免費依法・電話口譯・真人到場💺｜聽完就敢開口問｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Asking the Clinic for an Interpreter
script.youtube_title_en: "Family Can't Be the Interpreter" — Asking the Clinic for Chinese Language Help
script.youtube_description:
「家屬不能擔任口譯」——在英文診所看診，怎麼開口請一位中文口譯？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在診所的櫃檯前。

你會聽到：怎麼在有預約的基礎上提出口譯請求；「語言協助依法免費」的說法與費用問答；為什麼家人不能幫忙翻譯；真人口譯要提前四十八小時預約、臨時沒人可用時的電話口譯備用方案；還有簽到時間、延遲抵達的寬限、白紙黑字的確認小卡。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人說話的自然語感：um、well、so、hmm、wow。聽完你就會用：Can I have、Is there a charge、What time exactly works、Call ahead。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Family can't be the interpreter" — what do you say when the clinic visit is in English but your ears need Chinese? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the clinic front desk.

You will hear: asking for a Chinese interpreter on top of an existing appointment; learning that language help is free by law; why family members are not allowed to translate; booking a live interpreter forty-eight hours ahead, plus the phone-interpreter backup plan when nobody is free.

Everything stays in A2-level words with natural spoken rhythm: um, well, so, hmm, wow. By the end you'll own phrases like Can I have..., Is there a charge..., What time exactly works..., and Call ahead.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
看診全程英文，只能點頭微笑裝懂？想請一位中文口譯，不知道可不可以、要不要錢、該提前多久開口？

這一集帶大家走到診所櫃檯前，從提出口譯請求、得知語言協助依法免費，到家屬不能擔任口譯的規定、四十八小時的預約規則，還有電話口譯備用方案，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🗣️ 開口請求：Can I have a Chinese interpreter with me?
💵 費用確認：Is there a charge for that service?
📞 備用方案：Then we use a phone interpreter, no stress.
📋 白紙黑字：Can I get this in writing?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著吳先生走這一趟櫃檯，下次你需要幫自己爭取語言協助時，句子自己就會說出來。

祝你每次看診都聽得懂、問得清。
